## What I want to know

A clear and concise description of your question.

## What I've already tried

What have you already tried to answer this question? (e.g. read the README, read CONTRIBUTING, searched issues, looked at the data model in the backend-ecosystem repo)

## Context

Anything else that might help us answer your question — your deployment setup, your use case, whether you are a self-hoster or a DescribeAT staff member, what part of the admin portal you're trying to use or modify.

## Is this about…

- [ ] Setting up the admin portal against my own backend
- [ ] Understanding a specific page, component, or workflow
- [ ] The data model (titles, AD tracks, notifications, feedback, users)
- [ ] Permissions / authentication / authorisation
- [ ] Accessibility of the admin UI
- [ ] Contributing a change (use the Feature or Bug report templates instead)
- [ ] Something else (describe above)
